MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 fits my Fire TV and Alexa setup, and its screen could help me view compatible security cameras.",
    "The Blink bundle feels like a useful next step because a doorbell and additional cameras could extend the coverage I started with my XT2."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The earbuds and portable speaker serve listening needs I have not expressed; my recent purchases focus on home viewing, recording, and security.",
    "The USB hub does not solve a current problem for me, and owning electronics alone does not mean I need more connections."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in home electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in unrelated electronic accessories.",
    "Alexa relevance only goes so far: the Echo Dot and Echo Show 5 fit my setup, but I would choose the larger Show 8 rather than buy several overlapping devices."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility with what I already own matters: I would check whether the Blink bundle works with my XT2 setup and whether a display supports my cameras.",
    "Accessories need a specific purpose. Memory cards might support my camcorder, but I would verify compatibility and recording capacity before deciding whether I need one or two.",
    "I would prioritize extending my existing Blink setup over adding a WYZE camera that requires another app."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my connected home interests but sometimes treated any electronic device or accessory as a useful next purchase."
}
